title: Vertex type
statement: For a circuit with $n$ input vertices and a list of gates, define the type of vertex $i$ to be absent when $i<n$. When $i\ge n$, it is the kind of the gate at list position $i-n$, if that position exists, and absent otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: For $i\ge n$, use the gate at position $i-n$ when it exists
